Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL2971. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Filter by assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2971'. Use INNER JOIN compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Return columns molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
